SavedApp.title: SavedApp
SavedApp.description: A software package or mobile app saved by an authenticated user in their personal cross-platform library.

appKey.description: Normalized unique identifier for the software entry.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this saved software record.

platform.description: Target OS platform of the software.

name.description: Display name of the software or application.

iconUrl.description: Thumbnail or icon URL for the software.

secondaryUrl.description: Direct installer, F-Droid repository, or secondary download link.

license.description: Software license model (e.g., GPL-3.0, MIT, Proprietary, App Store).

notes.description: User personal notes or tags for this software.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was last updated.

SearchHistoryItem.title: SearchHistoryItem
SearchHistoryItem.description: A record of a live cross-platform search executed by an authenticated user.

query.description: Search term entered by the user.

platform.description: Selected platform at the time of search.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who executed the search.

topResultName.description: Name of the primary matched software.

topResultIcon.description: Thumbnail icon URL of the primary matched software.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the search was recorded.

/users/{userId}/savedApps/{appId}.description: User-scoped collection of bookmarked PC, Android, and iOS software packages.

/users/{userId}/searchHistory/{historyId.description: User-scoped log of recent live software searches.
